page: UpCloud PREMIUM-64xCPU-384GB is a high-capacity virtual server built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an AMD EPYC 9575F processor operating at 2.0 GHz. The configuration delivers 64 physical cores and 64 vCPUs with a single thread per core under a shared CPU allocation model. The system is equipped with 384.0 GB of RAM, translating to 6.0 GB of memory per core. Local storage consists of a bundled 500 GB SSD, and the instance includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier performance across multiple compute-heavy and data-processing workloads. The server achieves top 10% placement in both single-core and multi-core stress-ng CPU evaluations, as well as PassMark CPU, extended instructions, encryption, and physics tests. Memory performance is mixed; while small-block cached read-only memory bandwidth ranks in the top 10%, large-block uncached read and write bandwidths place in the top 25%, and the PassMark memory score falls in the middle 50%. The processor supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and cryptography acceleration, contributing to top-tier results in gzip compression, bzip3 decompression, and Redis SET operations.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the server offers high resource density, combining a substantial 64-core compute allocation with a large 384.0 GB memory footprint. This profile is highly suitable for demanding multi-threaded applications, database operations, and static web serving, where it demonstrates strong to top-tier throughput. It is also capable of handling moderate AI workloads, showing strong performance in prompt processing and text generation for medium-sized 7B LLM models, though it is constrained to CPU-based execution due to the absence of dedicated GPU hardware.
description: UpCloud PREMIUM-64xCPU-384GB is a KVM-based virtual server featuring 64 vCPUs and 64 physical cores powered by an AMD EPYC 9575F processor running at 2.0 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture, it is equipped with 384.0 GB of RAM (6.0 GB per core) and a bundled 500 GB local SSD. The server demonstrates top-tier CPU performance in stress-ng and PassMark benchmarks, alongside strong large-block memory bandwidth. While it lacks dedicated GPU hardware, its advanced instruction support (including AVX-512) enables top-tier results in data compression, cryptography, and Redis operations, as well as strong performance in medium-sized LLM inference. This high-density configuration is optimized for multi-threaded enterprise applications, database operations, static web serving, and heavy data-processing workloads.
